purpose: Define P2P message delivery over established peer transport with explicit sender, conversation, payload and delivery state while keeping payload separate from rendezvous/signaling.

topics.name: Messaging Message Delivery
topics.purpose: Define P2P message delivery over established peer transport with explicit sender, conversation, payload and delivery state while keeping payload separate from rendezvous/signaling.

semantics.message_rule: Each message has an explicit message identity, sender identity and conversation ref.
semantics.transport_rule: Payload is delivered over established WebRTC/other approved P2P transport.
semantics.hello_rule: Hello/rendezvous carries bootstrap metadata only and does not store/deliver normal application message payload.
semantics.state_rule: Queued/sent/delivered/failed states are explicit where supported.
semantics.file_rule: Binary file payload retains file identity/metadata separately from message envelope.
semantics.inert_rule: Received text/file payload is inert and does not directly execute commands.
semantics.failure_rule: Transport failure is explicit and does not silently reroute payload through rendezvous.

invariants.rule: Messaging is explicit peer/group communication over governed peer transport; rendezvous, transport, conversation policy and message payload remain separate semantic layers.

hard_gates.condition: message payload sent through Hello by default

prose.summary: Define P2P message delivery over established peer transport with explicit sender, conversation, payload and delivery state while keeping payload separate from rendezvous/signaling.
notes: Unlocked pending reconciliation against existing msg/WebRTC/Hello contracts and whole-tree Contract Format 1.4 validation.
